english.title: Print promote or publish publication re candidate without relevant details of printer/publisher on single side sheet
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) were

(A)_[the promoter of material which could reasonably be regarded as intended to promote or procure the election of a candidate, namely **(..SPECIFY CANDIDATE..), at an election, namely **(..SPECIFY ELECTION..), and which was published in a document consisting of, or principally consisting of, a single side of printed matter]_
(B)_[the publisher of material which could reasonably be regarded as intended to promote or procure the election of a candidate, namely **(..SPECIFY CANDIDATE..), at an election, namely **(..SPECIFY ELECTION..), and was in a document consisting of, or principally consisting of, a single side of printed matter]_
(C)_[the printer of a document consisting of a single side of printed matter and containing material which could reasonably be regarded as intended to promote or procure the election of a candidate, namely **(..SPECIFY CANDIDATE..), at an election, namely **(..SPECIFY ELECTION..),]_

when the name and address of

(D)_[the printer of the document]_
(E)_[the promoter of the material]_
(F)_[a person on behalf of whom the material was being published]_
(G)_[**(..SPECIFY COMBINATION OF ABOVE..)]_

did not appear on the face of that document
english.legislation: Contrary to section 110(2)(a), (4) and (9) of the Representation of the People Act 1983.

other.penalty:
Summary: A fine not exceeding level five on the standard scale.Time limit for prosecutions:
Complex - see section 176

Note
Note that for offences committed since 12 March 2015, section 85 of the Legal Aid, Sentencing and Punishment of Offenders Act 2012 removes the limits on certain fines given by the Magistrates' Courts. Offences that were previously punishable by fines of 'prescribed sums' and that were limited to 'not exceeding level 5 on the standard scale' or 'not exceeding the statutory maximum', are now punishable by a fine of any amount.
